label: TK/MUNDAT InspectR Policy Scope
description: Three design-time TK/MUNDAT policy rules evaluated by the InspectR PoC (rule set tk-v2.0)

children.label: TK-R1 — DPIA and risk-assessment checkpoint
children.description: IF a data_source declares contains_special_category_data: true THEN one compliance_gate declares dpia_checkpoint_defined: true and risk_assessment_checkpoint_defined: true.

children.label: TK-R2 — Lineage record for integrated data
children.description: IF the design contains a data_integration node THEN every data_integration node declares lineage_record_defined: true.

children.label: TK-R3 — Purpose compatibility before sharing
children.description: IF a data_transfer node exists and a data_source declares contains_personal_data: true THEN the compliance gates that carry purpose_compatibility_declared all declare true.
